summary: Most of the frustration centres on security and privacy concerns, followed by payment and access issues and technical bugs and stability. Users report illegal content, scams, and misuse of the platform for predatory behavior. Concerns about lack of moderation and potential exposure of private content are common. Some users feel the platform is unsecure and not properly moderated by law enforcement or internal systems.

themes.name: Customer Support and Engagement
themes.description: Users report poor customer support, with no human assistance and unresponsive bots. Some users feel the platform is not reliable for important communications due to lack of support.
themes.recommendation: Improve customer support channels, add human support options, and increase transparency in support processes.

themes.name: Technical Bugs and Stability
themes.description: Users report app crashes, frozen accounts, and issues with group and chat functionality. Some users mention problems with voice messages and SMS verification. Technical instability is a recurring issue.
themes.recommendation: Fix critical bugs, improve app stability, and enhance customer support for technical issues.

themes.name: User Experience and Interface
themes.description: Users report missing features like message themes and gift removal, and some suggest adding more customization options. There is a desire for more visual and functional enhancements.
themes.recommendation: Add requested features, improve UI/UX, and gather more user feedback on design improvements.
